responsibility: Implements the V850 C front-end hooks for Green Hills compatible pragmas and related target-specific source annotations. It parses #pragma ghs section and the start/end TDA/SDA/ZDA pragmas, maintains the nested current small-data-area stack, handles #pragma ghs interrupt by attaching the interrupt attribute to the current function, and emits warnings for malformed or mismatched pragmas, providing the language-side control that later drives V850 section and data-area placement.
